ogTitle: YouTube Timestamp Link - Jump to the Exact Second
ogDescription: Create a share link and a comment-ready timestamp for any moment in a YouTube video.
ldDescription: Generate a YouTube share URL that starts at a chosen time, together with a readable timestamp for comments and descriptions.
lede: Paste a video link and a time such as 1:42, and get a share link that opens exactly there - plus the timestamp text for your comment or description.

faq.a: Watch links, youtu.be short links, Shorts, Live and embed URLs, or just the 11-character video ID. Other parameters in the link are kept unless they conflict.

faq.q: What is the difference between t and start?
faq.a: The link uses t, the parameter YouTube's own Share button writes. Embedded players also accept start; the tool shows both forms so you can copy the one you need.

faq.q: Can the timestamp be negative or past the end?
faq.a: No. Times must be zero or later, and you should use a time inside the video. The tool shows the parsed time in seconds so you can check it before copying.
